_comment: Project config for `npm run smoke` and the cross-validation in test/integration.test.ts. It pins every setting the predicted routing depends on, so the run is deterministic whatever the machine's global ~/.pi/agent/modelrouter.json says: the two faux models as the tiers, a Jev transport whose credential is never present (so routing falls to src/router.ts#heuristicTier, offline), and a confidence bar the heuristic can clear.
